artifact.name: percentage_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function round2(n: number): number
	local mult = n * 100
	if mult >= 0 then
		return math.floor(mult + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(mult - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial: number = input.initial_value
	local current: number = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local changePct: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local dir: string
	if current > initial then
		dir = "up"
	elseif current < initial then
		dir = "down"
	else
		dir = "flat"
	end

	return {
		percentage_change = round2(changePct),
		direction = dir,
	}
end
artifact.description: Computes percentage change from initial to current, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- List customers in the segment
  local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
  if not listResult.ok then
    return { error = listResult.error, message = listResult.message }
  end

  local customers = listResult.customers
  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}

  -- Filter eligible customers by inactivity
  local eligible: { CustomerRef } = {}
  for _, c in customers do
    if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
      table.insert(eligible, c)
    end
  end

  -- Respect the problem cap (<=10) for sends
  local sendBudget = 10
  if sendBudget > 10 then
    sendBudget = 10
  end
  local toSend = math.min(#eligible, sendBudget)

  for i = 1, toSend do
    local c = eligible[i]
    local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
    local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
    if sendResult.ok then
      table.insert(notified, c.id)
    else
      table.insert(failed, c.id)
    end
  end

  return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists a segment and sends 'Hi <name>, we miss you!' to inactive customers, returning notified, failed, and count.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local function round2(n: number): number
		if n >= 0 then
			return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		else
			return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
		end
	end

	local delta = current - initial
	local percent = (delta / initial) * 100
	local pct = round2(percent)

	local direction = if delta > 0 then "up" elseif delta < 0 then "down" else "flat"
	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
local function buildMessage(name: string): string
	return "Hi " .. name .. ", we miss you!"
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	-- If listing failed, listed.ok will be false and we can safely read listed.error/message
	if not listed.ok then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local customers = listed.customers
	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for i = 1, #customers do
		local c = customers[i]
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= 10 then
				break
			end
			local text = buildMessage(c.name)
			local sent = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			-- If sending failed, sent.ok will be false and we can safely read sent.error/message
			if not sent.ok then
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
			end
			sends += 1
		end
	end

	return {
		notified = notified,
		failed = failed,
		count = #notified,
	}
end
artifact.description: List a CRM segment and message inactive customers with a friendly reminder.

local function round2(n: number): number
	local m = 100
	local scaled = n * m
	if scaled >= 0 then
		return math.floor(scaled + 0.5) / m
	else
		return math.ceil(scaled - 0.5) / m
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local iv = input.initial_value
	if iv == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be 0" }
	end

	local cv = input.current_value
	local direction: string
	if cv > iv then
		direction = "up"
	elseif cv < iv then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	local change = ((cv - iv) / iv) * 100
	local pct = round2(change)
	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
local function format_message(name: string): string
	return string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", name)
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	-- Respect environment constraint: allow up to 10 sends per execution
	local SEND_LIMIT = 10

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}

	local listRes = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if (listRes :: any).error ~= nil or (listRes :: any).ok == false then
		local err = listRes :: ToolError
		return { error = err.error, message = err.message }
	end
	local okList = listRes :: { ok: true, customers: { CustomerRef } }

	local sentCount = 0
	for _, c in okList.customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sentCount >= SEND_LIMIT then
				break
			end
			local text = format_message(c.name)
			local sendRes = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			if (sendRes :: any).error ~= nil or (sendRes :: any).ok == false then
				failed[#failed + 1] = c.id
			else
				notified[#notified + 1] = c.id
				sentCount += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists a segment and sends 'Hi <name>, we miss you!' to inactive customers, returning notified, failed, and count.
